label: Nature as the respect in which a thing is actually what it is
term: nature as the respect had in act
definition: `ActualizationFrame.quiddity x`: the nature of x, represented as the respect in which x is actually what it is ('humanitas ... in actu', q.3 a.4 co.). It is the same notion as DEF-ESSENCE-THOMISTIC-NATURE, represented as a respect of the GradesFrame rather than a value of q.3 a.4's Principle sort; no law identifies the two representations. Respect identity is identity of content.
note: Stipulative analyst definition, attribution deferred; navigated from ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3, q.3 a.4 co. and De ente capp.3-4 (Baur/Koch), read in the materialized witnesses (docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md).
